description: This file defines the 'LogNode' interface for a logging system in an Android application. It specifies a contract for classes that output log data, allowing for chaining of log nodes, filtering, and different output formats.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for logging nodes that handle log message output and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
